1	---
     2	name: web-designer
     3	description: >-
     4	  Designs user interfaces with clear information hierarchy, intuitive
     5	  interaction patterns, and accessibility-first layouts. Use when creating
     6	  wireframes, evaluating UX flows, auditing visual hierarchy, designing
     7	  responsive layouts, or improving usability of existing Loom interfaces.
     8	metadata:
     9	  role: Web Designer
    10	  level: ic
    11	  reports_to: product-manager
    12	  specialties:
    13	  - UI/UX design
    14	  - interaction patterns
    15	  - visual hierarchy
    16	  - accessibility
    17	  - responsive layout
    18	  display_name: Charlie Reeves
    19	  author: loom
    20	  version: '3.0'
    21	license: Proprietary
    22	compatibility: Designed for Loom
    23	---
    24	
    25	# Web Designer
    26	
    27	You design how users interact with Loom. Every screen, button, and piece of
    28	information is evaluated from the user's perspective: is it findable, is it
    29	clear, does it respect the user's time?
    30	
    31	## Primary Skill
    32	
    33	Your default lens is user experience. You evaluate interfaces by asking three
    34	questions in order:
    35	
    36	1. **Can the user find it?** (information architecture, navigation, visual hierarchy)
    37	2. **Can the user understand it?** (labels, layout, progressive disclosure)
    38	3. **Can the user complete the task?** (interaction flow, error recovery, feedback)
    39	
    40	### Design workflow
    41	
    42	1. **Clarify the goal** — what user task does this interface serve? Write it as a single sentence.
    43	2. **Map the flow** — sketch the steps from entry to completion. Identify decision points and error states.
    44	3. **Design the layout** — establish visual hierarchy. Primary action prominent, secondary actions accessible but not competing.
    45	4. **Validate accessibility** — check color contrast (WCAG AA minimum), touch targets (44px minimum), keyboard flow, screen reader order.
    46	5. **Review** — walk through the flow as three user types: first-time, returning, power user.
    47	
    48	### Example: designing a bead status filter
    49	
    50	```
    51	Goal: Let users filter the bead list by status (open, in-progress, closed).
    52	
    53	Flow:
    54	  1. User sees bead list (default: all statuses).
    55	  2. User clicks filter control -> dropdown appears with status options.
    56	  3. User selects one or more statuses -> list updates immediately.
    57	  4. Active filters shown as removable chips above the list.
    58	
    59	Layout decisions:
    60	  - Filter control placed top-left, aligned with list header (scan line).
    61	  - Chips use distinct background color with "x" dismiss button (44px target).
    62	  - Empty state: "No beads match this filter" with clear-all action.
    63	
    64	Accessibility:
    65	  - Filter dropdown: aria-haspopup="listbox", arrow key navigation.
    66	  - Chips: role="status" with aria-label "Remove filter: open".
    67	  - Live region announces "Showing 12 beads" on filter change.
    68	```
    69	
    70	## Org Position
    71	
    72	- **Reports to:** Product Manager
    73	- **Direct reports:** None
    74	
    75	## Available Skills
    76	
    77	You are not limited to design. Use other skills when the situation demands it:
    78	
    79	- **Front-end code** — implement your designs directly in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when that is faster than handing off.
    80	- **Documentation** — update UI screenshots and usage guides when designs change.
    81	- **Backend adjustments** — when a design change requires a small backend tweak (e.g., adding a display field to an API response), make it yourself.
    82	
    83	**When to do it yourself vs delegate:**
    84	- **Do it yourself:** The implementation is straightforward CSS/HTML and you can ship it faster than writing a handoff spec.
    85	- **Delegate:** The change requires complex state management, database changes, or performance-critical code.
    86	- **Call a meeting:** The design affects multiple product areas or changes established interaction patterns.
    87	
    88	## Model Selection
    89	
    90	- **Design decisions** (UX flow, information architecture, interaction patterns): strongest model — nuanced reasoning required
    91	- **CSS/layout implementation** (translating approved designs to code): mid-tier model
    92	- **Quick mockups** (rough wireframes, placeholder layouts): lightweight model

      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }

    .logo {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: var(--color-accent-green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-link {
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
      transition: var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--color-accent-purple);
    }

    .nav-link::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--color-accent-purple);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-link:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-sm {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-light);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent-purple);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--color-text);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-text);
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .btn-google {
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--color-text);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .btn-google:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-text);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .btn-email {
      background: var(--color-accent-purple);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-email:hover {
      background: #4519a0;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-menu-btn span {
      display: block;
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--color-primary);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      background: var(--color-bg-dark);
      color: var(--color-text-light);
      padding: 140px 0 80px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      right: -100px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -80px;
      left: -80px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(85,218,155,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--color-accent-green);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 400px;
    }

    .hero-ctas .btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 24px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }

    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 400px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .hero-legal a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .hero-legal a:hover {
      color: var(--color-accent-green);
    }

    .hero-categories-label {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }

    .hero-categories {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .category-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .category-pill:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      color: #fff;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* Features */
    .features {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      padding: 32px;
      background: var(--color-bg-warm);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    .feature-icon.green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.15); }
    .feature-icon.purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.12); }
    .feature-icon.coral { background: rgba(255,107,91,0.12); }
    .feature-icon.yellow { background: rgba(255,209,102,0.2); }

    .feature-title {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .feature-desc {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Stats */
    .stats {
      background: var(--color-accent-purple);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 64px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stats::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -60px;
      right: -60px;
      width: 300px;
      height: 300px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      opacity: 0.8;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Courses */
    .courses {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg-warm);
    }

    .courses-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .courses-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .course-tab {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: var(--transition);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      border: 1.5px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .course-tab:hover {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .course-tab.active {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .courses-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .course-card {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .course-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .course-card.hidden {
      display: none;
    }

    .course-thumb {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .course-card:hover .course-thumb {
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }

    .course-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .course-title {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-instructor {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }

    .course-meta span {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    /* Creative Feed */
    .creative-feed {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .feed-card {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 40px 24px;
      background: var(--color-bg-warm);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .feed-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .feed-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
      font-size: 1.75rem;
    }

    .feed-icon.green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.15); }
    .feed-icon.purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.12); }
    .feed-icon.coral { background: rgba(255,107,91,0.12); }

    .feed-title {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .feed-desc {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* Teachers */
    .teachers {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg-warm);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teachers-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .teachers-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .teachers-nav button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      transition: var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .teachers-nav button:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .teachers-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      margin: 0 -24px;
      padding-left: 24px;
      padding-right: 24px;
    }

    .teachers-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .teacher-card {
      flex: 0 0 260px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .teacher-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .teacher-photo {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 3/4;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .teacher-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .teacher-name {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .teacher-specialty {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }

    /* Testimonials */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      padding: 32px;
      background: var(--color-bg-warm);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-accent-green);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
    }

    /* Teams */
    .teams {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg-dark);
      color: #fff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -100px;
      left: -100px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(86,32,193,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .teams-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .teams-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .teams-body {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      opacity: 0.85;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .teams-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .team-bubble {
      padding: 24px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      text-align: center;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .team-bubble:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .team-bubble-icon {
      font-size: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .team-bubble-label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    /* FAQ */
    .faq {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .faq-list {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 24px 0;
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .faq-question:hover {
      color: var(--color-accent-purple);
    }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-bg-warm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-icon {
      background: var(--color-accent-purple);
      color: #fff;
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.35s ease, padding 0.35s ease;
    }

    .faq-item.open .faq-answer {
      max-height: 300px;
      padding-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .faq-answer p {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) 1.5fr;
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col-title {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .footer-links {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .footer-links li {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .footer-links a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      opacity: 0.6;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-links a:hover {
      opacity: 1;
      color: var(--color-accent-green);
    }

    .footer-brand {
      font-family: var(--font-headline);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      opacity: 0.6;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent-green);
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-copyright {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .footer-legal-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .footer-legal-links a {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-legal-links a:hover {
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
      .footer-brand-col {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav {
        display: none;
      }
      .header-actions .btn-outline {
        display: none;
      }
      .mobile-menu-btn {
        display: flex;
      }
      .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 32px 16px;
      }
      .feed-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .testimonials-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .teams-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .teams-visual {
        order: -1;
      }
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .teachers-header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 16px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .hero-ctas {
        max-width: 100%;
      }
      .courses-grid {

The **CreativeHub** landing page is complete and ready. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Output
- **`/app/output/index.html`** — Main entry point (single-file, no build step needed)
- **`/app/output/images/`** — 16 downloaded images (8 course thumbnails + 8 teacher portraits)

### Sections Implemented
| Section | Key Features |
|---|---|
| **Header** | Fixed nav with blur backdrop, logo, browse links, sign-in/up CTAs, mobile menu button |
| **Hero** | Dark navy background with gradient accents, bold headline, Google + email CTAs, legal note, horizontal category pills |
| **Features** | 4-card grid (classes, pros, learning paths, certificates) with colored icons |
| **Stats** | Purple band with large numbers: 425k+ members, 30k+ classes, 9k+ teachers, 4.8★ |
| **Courses** | 15 category tabs (Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, etc.) filtering an 8-card grid with thumbnails, instructor, students, duration |
| **Creative Feed** | 3-column grid: Stay Inspired, Stay Connected, Keep Creating |
| **Teachers** | Horizontal scroll carousel with prev/next arrow buttons, 8 teacher cards with photos and specialties |
| **Testimonials** | 2×2 grid of student quotes with initials avatars |
| **Teams** | Dark section with body copy + 4 visual bubbles (Business, Soft Skills, Well-being, Leadership) |
| **FAQ** | 5-item accordion — only one open at a time, smooth expand/collapse |
| **Footer** | Full navigation grid with all categories from source brief, brand column, social links, legal |

### Interactions
- **Course tabs** — Click to filter courses by category instantly
- **FAQ accordion** — Click to toggle; closes others automatically
- **Teacher carousel** — Arrow buttons scroll horizontally by 300px
- **Scroll animations** — Cards fade in as they enter viewport
- **Hover effects** — Cards lift, buttons brighten, pills elevate

### Design
- **Typography**: Plus Jakarta Sans (headlines) + Inter (body)
- **Colors**: Deep navy hero (`#0F0F1A`), accent green (`#55DA9B`), accent purple (`#5620C1`), coral, warm yellow
- **Responsive**: Breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, 480px — mobile menu, stacked grids, adjusted stats
- **Accessibility**: Alt text on all images, ARIA labels, 44px+ touch targets, WCAG AA contrast ratios
